marks.gloss_en: תניא כוותיה דרב: under four all agree kasher; with four R' Meir invalidates and R' Yehuda validates
if he roofed with cedar boards that do not have four, all agree it is kesheira
תניא כוותיה דשמואל: with four all agree pasul; under four R' Meir invalidates and R' Yehuda validates
if he roofed with cedar boards that have four, all agree it is pesula
אמר רבי יהודה: מעשה בשעת הסכנה ... וישבנו תחתיהן -- we sat beneath boards of four, so they are valid roofing
אמרו לו: משם ראיה? אין שעת הסכנה ראיה
R' Yehuda: there was an incident in a time of danger when we brought boards that had four, roofed over a porch, and sat beneath them
לימא מסייע ליה: a board four wide, even if only three tefachim were brought inside -- pesula; היכי דמי, לאו כגון שהפכן על צידיהם?

the baraita: a sukkah not holding his head, most of his body and his table; or breached by a breach a kid could leap through headfirst; or on which he placed a board four tefachim wide, even if he brought only three tefachim inside -- pesula
לא, הכא במאי עסקינן -- כגון דאנחה אפומא דמטללתא, דעייל תלתא לגיו ואפיק חד לבר, דהוה ליה פסל היוצא מן הסוכה (= p_psal_hayotze_kasukkah)
and all psal protruding from the sukkah is judged as the sukkah
לעולם דאית בהו ארבעה, ומאי מצטרפין -- מצטרפין לארבע אמות מן הצד (= p_mitztarfin_learba_amot_min_hatzad, aliba Rav)
'combine' means: combine to four amot from the side
לישנא אחרינא: for Rav, R' Meir's 'combine' is four amot from the side; but for R' Yehuda, who validates even boards of four, what is 'do not combine'? they are merely reeds!
איידי דקאמר רבי מאיר מצטרפין, אמר רבי יהודה אין מצטרפין -- the phrase is R' Meir's, echoed by R' Yehuda
'combine' means: combine to [the measure of] four [tefachim]
if he turned them on their sides: Rav Huna said, pesula
Rav Nachman: they became like metal skewers
